name: 1700185 Munchy crackers butter flavour
ingredients_raw: Wheat flour, vegetable fat (palm), sugar, lactose, starch (corn, tapioca), raising agents (ammonium bicarbonate, sodium bicarbonate, disodium diphosphate), milk powder, salt, malt extract, butter (milk fat) (0.2%), flavorings, yeast, emulsifier (sodium stearoyl lactylate), permitted food colouring (INS160a), flour treatment agent (protease)
